column1: Tab 7 — Recommendation Matrix: Intervention + NUCRIPCE + Timeline -> CTA

This is the core deliverable, expanding the 5 worked examples already in the v2 architecture spec (Section 7) into a fuller, buildable rule set. Run AFTER Tabs 1-6 have produced: capacity band, intervention trigger(s), demand present Y/N, NUCRIPCE driver tags, and Timeline code. Each row below is one recognisable pattern; the backend should match on capacity band + intervention + demand-presence first, then refine CTA wording using the specific driver tags/Timeline. v3: patterns 16-30 (pale yellow) were added in September 2026 to cover the new experience families, contexts, the Overdue timeline and the safety override.

column1: Non-negotiable rules across every pattern above (from v2 spec Section 11 / State-driven UI behaviour):
• Never present more than one primary CTA plus a small number of alternatives — never a long menu.
• ‘Not now’ / rejection is always a valid, unpenalised outcome; log it but do not repeat the same rejected suggestion immediately.
• Timeline can shorten a Regulate step but never skip a genuinely needed one, and never overrides a Support pathway.

• The user never sees the Energy-mood grid, ‘Intervention’ or ‘NUCRIPCE’ as labels — only the plain-language CTA, the name and icons of identified energy and mood level and rationale (‘Because you said X, Nuccess suggests Y.’).

When emotion is negative, and energy and mood is very low and very bad with inability to meet demand/need and intervention model isn't helpful after 1-2 weeks; prompt help button and ask is user would like professional help with assuring statement. for example, ' I know this maybe a tough time or period for you, you are not alone. We are here to support you in seeking the right help. You can do it". Then system prompt dial 999/111. if the situation is within 1 week, prompt Institutions support and recommend GP/ Institutions/ Local Authority (choose from drop down list in UK) or show self referral to Vita therapies (link) v3 NOTE: this sustained-state rule (1-2 weeks) is kept. Immediate risk language is handled separately and at once by pattern 28 - it never waits for a week-long trend.
• v3.2: Reflect and Meditate are never forced, never streaked and never offered INSTEAD of the Support pathway or the Safety override.

• v3.2: Meditate / Rituals / Prayer content comes only from what the user has chosen in My Practices or the neutral library. The engine never infers faith from profile data and never suggests a religious practice the user has not selected.
• v3.3: The primary action is always a tool included in the user's plan; every pathway has a free safety floor the engine can use in any light (Tab 6d, ENT-1/ENT-2).

• v3.3: No Advanced tiles, upgrade prompts or paywalls in Amber or Red, at High/Very High negative intensity, after a safety event or during a session; elsewhere at most ONE labelled Advanced alternative (ENT-3).
